founding.sentence: We started in a rented shed in 2014 because nobody in the valley would make a chair _meant to outlast its owner._
founding.signedBy: **Ines Hollin and Tom Achebe**, who still build the chairs

entries.title: Two people, one bench, a rented shed
entries.body: Tom left a kitchen fitter, Ines left a boatyard. The first order was six ladder-back chairs for a café in Todmorden.
entries.evidence: Lease signed 3 Mar 2014. The café still uses five of the six chairs.

entries.title: We started drawing before taking money
entries.body: A dining table went back because it was not what the client pictured. Since then every commission gets a full-size drawing first.
entries.evidence: 0 commissions returned for a design mismatch since.

entries.title: Moved into the old mill at Mytholm
entries.body: Room for a timber store, so we could buy whole boards from one tree and keep the grain matched across a piece.
entries.evidence: Rent went from £310 to £1,450 a month.

entries.title: Stopped selling anything veneered
entries.body: If it says solid oak, it is solid oak all the way through. It cost us the cheapest third of the catalogue.
entries.evidence: Sales dipped 14% that year, and were back by 2021.

entries.title: First two apprentices
entries.body: Three years, paid from day one, taught by whoever made the thing they are learning.
entries.evidence: 4 of 5 apprentices so far are still here.

entries.title: A bench just for repairs
entries.body: The fifty-year guarantee was eating Friday afternoons. Now one person does nothing but mend.

entries.title: Twelve people
entries.body: Nine makers, a finisher, Ines on drawings and Ruth in the office. We do not plan to grow past fifteen.

featured.name: Ines Hollin

featured.name: Dev Sharma

decided.line: Buy from within 60 miles where we can.
Sharpen by hand for the whole first year.
Keep a notebook of every mistake.

practices.rule: We draw it before we take a penny
practices.detail: A full-size drawing of your piece comes by post. You sign it, then you pay a deposit.
The person who cuts the first joint fits the last drawer, and signs it under the top.
practices.check: Look for the name under the drawer

practices.rule: We show you the boards first
practices.detail: Before cutting, we send photos of the actual boards, knots and all, so you choose.
Bring anything we made back for repair, whoever owns it now. You pay for the wood, not the time.
